verdict.rationale: The Claude Code docs site serves a working llms.txt (HTTP 200 with a documentation index) plus per-page .md variants (e.g. skills.md) explicitly designed for agent consumption, matching the story of pointing an agent at agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: independent third-party confirmation of llms.txt completeness/coverage beyond the index, and no evidence of llms.txt on the platform.claude.com API docs domain.
